text:
priya: Morning — quick micro-standup for deals+sec asks
priya: What I did: ran a feature walkthrough with MacroHealth, demo went well; uploaded SSO/KMS requests to the shared doc.
priya: Blockers: MacroHealth legal is asking about key custody — they want confirmation we support customer-managed keys / HSM options and an audit log retention SLA. Need engineering/security blurb to send.
priya: Today: chase answers, update pricing sheet, schedule pilot kickoff if we get green light.

mike-eng: @priya I can take the KMS/HSM questions. Quick clarifying q: do they require on-prem HSM or cloud KMS with external key wrap?
mike-eng: If they're cloud-KMS-first, we have a short compatibility table. For HSM/on-prem we need to scope Dedicated vs Private deployment.

anya-sales: MacroHealth follow-up: they also asked if we can do a short SOC2-like statement about access to logs for a third party. Who owns that? legal or security?

sec-bot: New security request created: SEC-4321 — "MacroHealth: KMS/HSM custody + audit log retention request". Assigned to: mike-eng, reviewer: security-team.

mike-eng: Copying what I can send them now — short notes for customer: 
```
- Support: cloud KMS (AWS/GCP/Azure) with customer-managed keys (CMK).
- External key wrap supported for Dedicated and Private deployments; on-prem HSM option available via Private package (requires procurement + installation).
- Audit logs: configurable retention up to 12 months by default; enterprise retention and long-term archival available via add-on.
```
mike-eng: Tagging @taylor for Dedicated sizing details.

priya: Perfect — can you compress that into a 2-3 line blurb I can paste into the legal thread?

mike-eng: Yeah — draft: "Redwood supports customer-managed keys via major cloud KMS providers. For stricter custody, we offer on-prem HSM as part of our Private deployment. Audit logs are configurable; enterprise retention options are available under our compliance add-ons."

priya: Great, sending now. Adding you to the MacroHealth legal thread.

anya-sales: Quick note — another prospect (Cortexa) asked about pilot capacity: want to confirm burst throughput and SLA for Dedicated pilot. taylor, can you drop the numbers? :eyes:

Taylor: For Dedicated pilot we generally size for steady-state X tokens/s and allow 2x burst for 30m windows. I'll drop a short table in the shared pricing doc. See internal note: <https://redwood.internal/pricing/dedicated-pilots>

mike-eng: Also, if they want autoscaling faster than default, there is a config knob (scale.cooldown, burst_factor). I can help tune once we see their seq len profile.

priya: Thanks all — blockers being handled. If security needs anything else for MacroHealth, ping this thread and I'll route. Otherwise I'll post a one-line update when legal responds. :white_check_mark:
